function carouselGoTo(c, idx): void;

Defined in: website/components/carousel/custom-carousel/nav.ts:87

Navigate to slide idx — accepts out-of-range idx (idx<0 or idx≥len) by scrolling to the CLONE slide at that edge, then scheduling an instant teleport to its real twin (the infinite-loop illusion). Also lazy-loads the new neighborhood and triggers loadHighRes on the active so the target slide upgrades immediately rather than on the next intersection tick. The double-modulo normalizes idx into [0,len) — a single % yields −1 for negative input.
